vo.speaker: coach
vo.text: Get your vision.
Replays show where the ball went…
never what the player saw.
Meet H8.
He gets a single look.
Nobody's watching H9.
Here's what he saw.
A look over his shoulder, and he finds the runner.
And he knows where his man is.
Take that look away, and re-run the match.

vo.speaker: coach
vo.text: Scan early, decide early.
Under a high press…
make him keep the ball, and the press wins it.
At a corner, it's the marker who has to look.
A whole match, live, with every key moment a tap away.
Take his eyes yourself.
Look the other way… he plays it safe.
Your call.
You only know what he knew.
He saw the run. Would you?
Behind every replay, a crew of agents.
Every line is checked against the simulation before it airs.
Try a wrong number…
and it never airs.
Take an agent down…
bring it back, and it picks up where it left off.
The same moment, for every fan, in every language.
Built on Microsoft Foundry and Agent Framework.
